description: A shell script for performance testing of the Git builtin FSMonitor, involving setup of repositories, enabling/disabling features, and running various test scenarios.

methods.name: enable_uc
methods.description: Enables untracked cache in the repository.

methods.name: disable_uc
methods.description: Disables untracked cache in the repository.

methods.name: start_fsm
methods.description: Starts the FSMonitor daemon and configures the repository to use it.

methods.name: stop_fsm
methods.description: Stops the FSMonitor daemon and unsets related configuration.

methods.name: do_status
methods.description: Runs 'git status' in the repository and measures performance.

methods.name: do_matrix
methods.description: Performs a series of repository state modifications and measurements under different configurations.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up test branches after tests.
